t2i_prompt: Flat UI mockup, no device frame, of one long web page for <CONTENT> shown as a full scroll overview. Near-black navy canvas; the page alternates full-width bands of deep navy and warm limestone off-white. Hero on navy: light thin uppercase title, isometric white line drawing of an industrial equipment skid and stacked mono key figures, one steel-blue button. Following bands hold hairline data tables, horizontal process chains of square boxes with glyphs and arrows, a branching diagram, a parameter grid, a checklist and an FAQ accordion. Light sans sentence-case headings, 1 px lines, flat vector, square corners, no shadows, a mobile column beside it.
signature_idea: The page's rhythm is a blueprint: navy bands for drawings and process, limestone sheets laid in for reading.
strengths: shows how every section type sits on one page, a true rhythm reference
dark/light alternation gives pace without decoration
light headlines and mono figures match the type system
isometric equipment drawing is an ownable visual
weaknesses: at thumbnail scale content is illegible; useful only as rhythm
beige and off-white light bands are two different neutrals, muddying the palette
process boxes and diagrams are generic block diagrams
many bands with equal weight, no climax
brand_fit_why: Navy and limestone grounds, one steel-blue accent, light headlines, mono figures, square corners and calm spacing match the brand book; it set the shipped page ground.
